name: What does basement trim actually do for a finished basement?

mainEntity.name: What does basement trim actually do for a finished basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, trim and molding can improve the finished look of a basement by hiding gaps, defining the room, and making walls look more complete. It also helps protect drywall edges from scuffs in high-traffic areas like hallways, family rooms, and basement stairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim makes a basement look finished, hides wall gaps, and protects drywall from wear. It is both a cosmetic upgrade and a practical finishing detail.
